author: Nanairo Nyaw
title: Looking for 2D Character Illustrator
content: **Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator** We'll provide character design concepts. You'll create high-quality, commercial-use illustrations with poses and backgrounds. Quality level matching the attached characters. Requirements: - Japanese anime art style (see attached images) - Experience with 2D game character art - Faithful to the original design (hair, outfit, colors) - work needs to match the quality of the attached examples (especially the coloring). To apply: Send your portfolio. Feel free to reach out! Contact via PM to Nanairo Nyaw.
